rows.label: Grustrag Three Beacon
rows.note: the one real accelerator; buy as many as you can

conditions: A beacon doesn't work in Invasion missions. Use it in a normal Grineer mission; only one beacon type works per mission.

groups.activity: play the first 5 minutes of the mission, then kill the Three
conditions: They can only spawn in the first 5 minutes of a mission, and each marked squad member raises the chance.
No spawns in Assassination, Syndicate, Arena, Sortie, Archimedea, Elite Sanctuary Onslaught, Landscape, Archwing or Empyrean missions.
Being captured fails the mission and attaches a Grustrag Bolt, which halves your damage to Grineer until you craft the free Bolt Release from the inbox.
Parts are untradeable, so every part is farmed yourself.
bonuses: Everyone in the squad can loot, marked or not.
